description: Pulls open job postings from the TheirStack API and turns them into structured hiring signals - open roles per domain, titles, seniority, posting dates, hiring team, plus free firmographics (headcount, funding stage, industry). Step 04 (signals) of the API-first GTM chain, and the discovery entry for hiring-defined ICPs. Use when the user wants hiring signals, open reqs, job postings, "who is hiring", "which of these companies are hiring X", "find companies hiring Y right now", open-role checks on a domain list or records.jsonl, or anything TheirStack. Sizing counts bound every pull before spend - free without company filters, ~1 credit against a domain list - then 1 credit per job returned. For people who already joined - recent hires, headcount growth, funding rounds - use 04-crustdata-signals; for scoring and campaign angles, hand the records to 05-signal-builder.
